name: camby
caption:
PICK 2. TRADED 2 YEARS LATER 🎮🏀

• 1996: we took Marcus Camby 2nd overall
• 1998: we traded him to the Knicks on draft day for Charles Oakley and the rights to Sean Marks
• 2007: Camby was the NBA's Defensive Player of the Year

Camby or Oakley? Right move? 👇

facts.claim: Marcus Camby was selected second overall (pick 2, #2) by the Toronto Raptors in the 1996 NBA draft; in 1998 (two years later) he was traded to the New York Knicks in a draft-day deal for Charles Oakley and the draft rights of Sean Marks; NBA Defensive Player of the Year for 2006-07 (2007). ESPN ids Camby 125, Oakley 616.
